newsitem.title: RUSSIA: After freeze, sudden thaw turns killer in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: After freeze, sudden thaw turns killer in Moscow.

text.p: The Russian winter took a dangerous new turn on Wednesday as a sudden thaw brought huge icicles crashing from Moscow rooftops on to pavements below after one of the coldest New Years in recent memory.

A 47-year-old woman was killed by a falling block of ice on Tuesday night as she left a grocery store, police said. She was the first to die that way this year but several people are usually killed on the streets during the spring thaw.

Hundreds of city workers, equipped with ropes, axes and mountaineering harness, clambered around rooftops hacking down overhanging ice after the temperature rose suddenly to zero Celsius (32 degrees Fahrenheit) from minus 20C (minus 4F) at the weekend.

The unseasonal mild spell will come as a relief to the city's homeless drunks, however. Dozens have already frozen to death -- nine in the week after New Year alone -- and hundreds have been taken to hospital with frostbite.
